void use(List<int> items, Future<void> Function(int) operation, int width) {
  const serial = 1;
  final one = 1;
  // ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-dart
  mapWithConcurrency(items, 1, operation);
  // ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-dart
  mapWithConcurrency(items, operation, width: 1);
  // ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-dart
  mapWithConcurrency(items, operation, limit: 1);
  // ok: serial-bounded-helper-dart
  mapWithConcurrency(items, serial, operation);
  // ok: serial-bounded-helper-dart
  mapWithConcurrency(items, operation, limit: one);
  mapWithConcurrency(items, 4, operation);
  mapWithConcurrency(items, operation, width: 4);
  mapWithConcurrency(items, width, operation);
}
